notes.title: 1.2 Patch Details
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32096095/a5b48faba13b1e20be67a792d67fde5c8f83a717.png[/img]

Details for the latest patch:


- Now you can sort Leaderboards by any level you want to see the best players in each level
- You can view only friends on Leaderboards to quickly and easily check who is the greatest employee
- Slides in the Credits are now changing slightly slower
- Level 3 Robbery - Added reminder about pushing the Start Button
- Level 4 Squeeze it - Crystals are heating slower on Normal and Easy difficulty
- Level 14 Simon Says - Longer timers for entering the right pattern on Easy difficulty
- Level 15 Final Test - Improved animations for mechanical arms taking and giving items
- Aaand many other minor bug fixes

If you have any feedback please share it in the community hub, discord or mail me.

notes.title: 1.1 Patch Details
notes.notes:
Hello there!

Godly Corp has been out for a week now and after watching many YouTubers play the game and getting feedback directly from players, here are the first patch notes:


- Pushing the 'Start Button' is now easier 
- Fixed trigger for achievement 'This Was a Triumph'
- Changed default setting for Textures Quality - from Medium to High
- AI is not as distracting in first levels - cut some irrelevant lines
- Level 5 Drone - adjusted difficulty. Now on Easy you need only 3 crystals, on Normal 4 to complete the level
- Level 7 Night Shift - it's now easier to spot the creature on the camera
- Fixed bug when Leaderboards weren't loading sometimes
- Added few important 'missing people' to the credits


Planned things for future patches:
- Leaderboards - friends tab and more suited for many users
- Bonus levels
- Endless mode

If you have any feedback please share it in the community hub, discord or mail me.

notes.title: Updates all across and final release date
notes.notes:
Hey!

Long time no see! In the meantime Godly Corp has been getting a lot of updates! Most of the changes are briefly described here every month or so:
http://tr8torusstudios.com/index.php/category/devblog/

You can read up all about the levels, graphical changes and other stuff.
There is still a lot of polishing and changing going on. Actually, we could probably use more tester to get some feedback and make the game even better!
If you are interested please write to us at support@tr8torusstudios.com or through discord at Zeriver#9992


There is also the final, official release date for Godly Corp! December 13 is the big date! Get ready to game and remember to add Godly Corp to your Wishlist!
